why.en: Cox's Bazar resort fire kills at least 10—massive tragedy dominating social signals (tuptup resort trending 1000+).

why.en: Over 1,000 arrested daily with prisons bursting—serious domestic issue affecting justice system.

en.title: Deepfake videos spark TV backlash
en.text: A Bangladeshi TV channel faces backlash after posting deepfake videos of actresses. The controversy has ignited debates about digital abuse and content responsibility.

bn.title: ডিপফেক ভিডিও নিয়ে টিভি বিতর্ক

en.title: Chutney seller builds 600 crore empire
en.text: A success story trending in showbiz: a chutney vendor's journey to a 600 crore taka business empire shows Bengali entrepreneurial spirit.

bn.title: চাটনি বিক্রেতা থেকে ৬০০ কোটি সাম্রাজ্য

en.text: Bangladesh's chief advisor wins the prestigious Hillary Clinton Award in Washington, bringing international recognition.
